updates.ограничения: Official ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record last posted 2026-09-24: NCT04662905 remains RECRUITING, single-group, with estimated primary and overall completion 2029-01-01 and 200 planned participants. Change in ECAP is the sole registered primary measure; there are no listed secondary outcomes or posted results. The linked Freshwater/Rosella programming paper states that neither study collected baseline pain characteristics or therapy-efficacy outcomes such as pain relief or functional improvement. A planned ECAP measure is not an observed result or an analgesic endpoint.

This registry record remains metadata-only; no observed ECAP or pain efficacy result is established.
